english.title: Contravene a provision / condition of a building line
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[erected a new building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..), nearer to the centre line of the street than the building line prescribed under section 74(1)]_
(B)_[made a permanent excavation below the level of the street nearer to the centre line of the street than the building line prescribed under section 74(1)]_
(C)_[contravened a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), imposed in connection with the giving of a consent under section 74(2)]_

of the Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(5) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened
the provisions of section 74 /
a condition in connection with the giving of consent

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 1 on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £2 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
